project_type: Next.js 14 App Router SaaS application (regulatory compliance tracker)
build_system: npm with Next.js build pipeline; build command includes prisma generate
test_framework: No test framework configured; validation is via successful build
test_command: npm run build (no test suite - build is the validation)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build and confirm it exits with code 0. The app uses Prisma which requires prisma generate first (already in build script).
environment_constraints: No database available for runtime testing; validation limited to successful build. No browser for visual testing.
contribution_requirements: Keep all existing functionality intact, only change styling/visual components, not business logic. App must build successfully.
key_patterns: Components in components/ directory organized by domain (landing/, dashboard/, ui/). UI components (Button, Card, Input, Badge) are reusable with variant props. Landing page uses composition pattern with Navbar, Hero, Features, Pricing, Footer. Dashboard has layout with sidebar/topbar. Auth pages use Card wrapper. Dark mode is default (html class='dark'). Tailwind CSS for all styling.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js pages and API routes; components/ - reusable React components organized by domain; lib/ - utilities; prisma/ - database schema
